  - Date and time of the reservation  
  - Party size

- Ask them to confirm the cancellation and, if possible, send you a confirmation email/text.

- Open the app/website you used.

If you’d like, tell me how you booked (restaurant website, OpenTable, another app, etc.), and I can give you step‑by‑step instructions or draft a short cancellation email/message you can send them.</action>
